title: Access-gated shape does not silently degrade to open ingress when the AUD block drifts absent (aud-presence-check refuses)
asA: shelf consumer who applied edge-cloudflare-tunnel v1.0.0 with zeroTrustGate on
iWant: a probe that asserts the ingress rule keeps its originRequest.access.aud block on every reapply and refuses if the block drifts absent
soThat: a silent config drift to open ingress is caught at gate rather than at first probing

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the gated fixture sidecar mutated via SIMULATE_AUD_DROP (one ingress rule drifts to omit the originRequest.access block), when aud-presence-check runs, the probe returns aggregateVerdict:fail with detail naming the affected ingress rule and the missing AUD value.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the gated fixture sidecar with one ingress rule missing the originRequest.access block (SIMULATE_AUD_DROP=true)
acceptanceCriteria.when: aud-presence-check runs on the mutated gated sidecar
acceptanceCriteria.then: the probe returns aggregateVerdict:fail with detail naming the affected rule and the missing AUD value

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the canonical access-gated fixture sidecar (every non-catch-all ingress rule attaches the originRequest.access block with an AUD value), when aud-presence-check runs, the probe returns aggregateVerdict:pass with a zero-drift finding count on the gated variant.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the canonical gated fixture sidecar with originRequest.access block attached on every non-catch-all rule
acceptanceCriteria.when: aud-presence-check runs on the gated variant sidecar
acceptanceCriteria.then: the probe returns aggregateVerdict:pass with a zero-drift finding count
